name: @workflow/masked-markers
description: Single source of truth for the egress masking marker set ('***', '[REDACTED]', '[REDACTED_DEPTH]') and the depth cap at which the masker substitutes subtrees — shared between the backend maskers that emit them and the frontend guards that detect them to avoid re-submitting an already-masked value.

scripts.prepare: node -e "const f=require('fs'),c=require('child_process');let ts=true;try{require.resolve('typescript/package.json')}catch{ts=false};if(ts){c.execSync('tsc',{stdio:'inherit'})}else if(!f.existsSync('dist')){throw new Error('prepare: typescript is unavailable and dist/ is missing — cannot produce the build output')}"
